'''Marcadian luxury cruisers''' were a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that acted as pleasure cruisers. One particular vessel was the ''[[Aurel Moon]]'', owned by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]].
